entities.summary: John Gordon "Gord" Perrin  is a Canadian volleyball player. He was a three–time Turkish Champion. Perrin is a retired member of the Canada men's national volleyball team, participating in two Olympic Games, as well as winning gold at the 2015 Men's NORCECA Volleyball Championship.
